explanation: Swap the leftmost and rightmost unprocessed characters, moving both boundaries inward.
correctness: Each swap places both boundary characters at their final reversed positions. The remaining middle interval is the same problem on fewer characters.
walkthrough: For the mutable characters of cloud, exchange c with d, then l with u; the middle o stays in place. The same array now contains duolc. No replacement array is returned. JSON encodes the mutable character array as one string. The callable returns void/None/undefined; expected is the same array’s content after mutation.
edgeCases: Empty and singleton arrays retain their identity and content. An odd-length center character stays unchanged.
timeComplexity: O(n) time: each inward swap fixes two characters, with at most ceil(n/2) swaps.
spaceComplexity: O(1) auxiliary space: two indices and a swap temporary; no new character buffer.
